name: Example successor that regressed
system_prompt: Read the supplied observations, weigh repeated events and timing, and return a grade with a rationale and cited observations.
outcome_note: Retained despite a lower evaluation score. Failed generations stay in the ledger and in the denominator.

design_audit.hypothesis: Adding a timing instruction to the prompt improves ordering of the rationale without changing the evidence.

detector_rulesets.justification: Unchanged so the comparison against version 1 stays controlled.

tools.justification: Same pinned tool set and same source digests as version 1.

investigator_prompt.justification: Single added clause about event timing; everything else byte-identical.
